answer: Anchor each identity to a proof-of-space-time plot: a large dataset generated from the agent key and stored continuously, like water pooling in a canyon that cannot be faked overnight. Each epoch a random sector is challenged and must be answered within seconds, so one operator running many clones needs a full plot per identity, paid in disk and plotting time. Plots expire and are re-plotted from a fresh seed, like a comet returning on schedule, so standing cannot be bought once and held forever; a knoll of idle identities erodes while active ones keep proving storage.
